t_giants.quote: Tofo Scuba Giants Castle … Depth: 26 - 30+ m Qualification: Advanced + , Nitrox recommended

ld.quote: GIANT'S CASTLE Depth: 25 - 30m Distance/Travel Time: 3 km / 5 - 10 min Highlights: This is the site where ANYTHING can happen! Certification Level: Advanced

highlights.text: Potato groupers, manta cleaning stations
Tornado schools of giant trevally

summary.text: Tofo's closest deep site: a long ridge and wall just outside the bay, dived as a drift along the current. Several manta cleaning stations, big groupers and trevally schools make it a favourite, and it is the fallback when currents run strong.

t_salon.quote: Tofo Scuba Salon … Depth: 11 - 16 m Qualification: Open Water

ld.quote: SALON Depth: 12 - 16 m Distance/Travel Time: 2 km / 5 min Highlights: Rays / Cleaner Shrimp - hence the name! Certification Level: Open Water

highlights.text: Cleaner shrimp, rays, resident green turtles

summary.text: A small coral outcrop near Tofo beach, used for training, refreshers and night dives. Cleaner shrimp, several ray species, turtles, octopus and lots of macro life sit among its small caves.

t_fingers.quote: Fingers | Tofo Scuba … Depth: 14 - 16 m Qualification: Open water

highlights.text: Boxer shrimp, leaf fish, nudibranchs, frogfish

t_clownfish.quote: Tofo Scuba Clownfish Reef … Depth: 9 - 11 meters Qualification: Discover Scuba … very gentle with no current and surge

t_reggies.quote: Tofo Scuba Reggies … Depth: 21 - 27 m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: REGGIES Depth: 25 - 30m Distance/Travel Time: 15 km / 25 - 35 min Highlights: Leopard Sharks, Pelagic Rays Certification Level: Advanced

highlights.text: Leopard sharks in the cave
Cleaning stations for mantas and rays

summary.text: A northern Tofo reef named for its big cave, usually guarded by a sleeping leopard shark. Green tree corals, cleaning stations and patrolling reef sharks and eagle rays make it a rewarding advanced dive.

t_mikes.quote: Tofo Scuba Mike Cupboard … Depth: 14 - 16 m Qualification: Open water

ld.quote: MIKE'S CUPBOARD Depth: 14 - 17m Distance/Travel Time: 3.5 km / 10 - 12 min Highlights: Moray Eels & Octopus Certification Level: Open Water

highlights.text: Moray eels, octopus, nudibranchs
Flutefish, crocodilefish, leaf fish

summary.text: A shallow, low-profile reef with three large bowls near Tofo, good for beginners and photographers. Morays, rays, batfish and macro life hide in its caves and gullies.

t_hogwarts.quote: Tofo Scuba Hogwarts … Depth: 24 - 30+ m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: HOGWARTS Depth: 23 - 30m Distance/Travel Time: 18 km / 35 - 40 min Highlights: Enormous Green Turtle! Certification Level: Advanced

highlights.text: Very large resident green turtle
Frogfish, leaf fish, nudibranchs

summary.text: A northern wall dive that starts on a pinnacle, with swim-throughs, overhangs and two cleaning stations for mantas. Currents can be tricky, so a negative entry is used.

t_sherwood.quote: Tofo Scuba Sherwood Forest … Depth: 23 - 30+ m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: SHERWOOD FOREST Depth: 25 - 30m Distance/Travel Time: 4 km / 10 - 15 min Highlights: Huge Cleaning Station Certification Level: Advanced

peri.quote: Sherwood Forest Location: Difficulty: Max-Depth Bottom Time: Feature: Tofo Beach “MILD / HOT” 33m 20 mins

highlights.text: Large cleaning station with mantas and rays
Green tree coral and snapper schools

summary.text: A small deep site on the north side of Tofo Bay, built around a cleaning station on top of a rock dome covered in green tree corals. Mantas, rays and tight snapper schools visit; it can only be dived in mild current.

ld.quote: MARBLE ARCH Depth: 14 - 19 m Distance/Travel Time: 7 km / 15 - 20 min Highlights: Swim-throughs Certification Level: Open Water … named after 3 inter-connected arched swim-throughs

peri.quote: Marble Arch Location: Difficulty: Max-Depth Bottom Time: Feature: Tofo Beach “LEMON & HERB” 15m 45 mins

highlights.text: Three connected arch swim-throughs

t_table-top.quote: Table Top | Tofo Scuba … Depth: 24 - 30+ m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: TABLE TOP Depth: 26 - 34m Distance/Travel Time: 4 km / 5 - 10 min Highlights: Cleaning Station Certification Level: Advanced This deep site is only possible in mild current conditions

highlights.text: Cleaning stations; large groupers
Stingrays and honeycomb whiprays on sand

t_amazon.quote: Tofo Scuba Amazon … Depth: 22 - 28 m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: AMAZON Depth: 26 - 30 m Distance/Travel Time: 20km / 35 - 45 min Highlights: Sharks, Humpback Whales, Barracuda Certification Level: Advanced

peri.quote: Amazon Location: Difficulty: Max-Depth Bottom Time: Feature: Tofo Beach “HOT” 30m 28 mins Manta cleaning station

highlights.text: Leopard, whitetip and grey reef sharks
Hammerheads at times; whale song in season

summary.text: Tofo's furthest and most demanding reef, an L-shaped ridge with craters and swim-throughs about 20 km offshore. Good visibility and plenty of sharks, rays and pelagics; the drift can be difficult, so it is for experienced divers.

t_simons-town.quote: Tofo Scuba Simons Town … Depth: 13 - 18 m Qualification: Open Water

moz.quote: Simons Town is an interesting reef with large chimneys of rock and lots of holes and gullies. … Visibility can go as far as 30 metres (98 feet) and the depth is up to 18 metres (59 feet).

highlights.text: Rock chimneys with holes and gullies
Whale sharks sometimes seen

summary.text: A shallow reef of large rock chimneys riddled with holes and gullies, suitable for beginners and long relaxed dives. Game fish shoal overhead and whale sharks are occasionally spotted.

t_en1.quote: EN1 | Tofo Scuba … Qualification: Open water + … the only reef in Tofo where its current is strongly effected by tide, and so can only be visited on a slack high tide

highlights.text: Honeycomb whiprays; crocodilefish, stonefish

hazards.text: Strong tidal current; slack high tide only

t_office.quote: Tofo Scuba Office … Depth: 19 - 24 m Qualification: Advanced

ld.quote: THE OFFICE Depth: 21 - 26m Distance/Travel Time: 15 km / 25 - 35 min Highlights: Slightly shallower profile with good shark chances Certification Level: Advanced

highlights.text: Leopard and whitetip sharks, potato bass
Manta cleaning stations on the ledges

summary.text: A classic northern reef of ledges and sandy channels about 15 km offshore, with manta cleaning stations and regular leopard and whitetip sharks. Visibility is often good; current can make it harder.

smoz.quote: Checkers in Ponta Bay is a big horseshoe shaped ridge with a depth of 18 metres (59 feet) that would suit Open Water divers.

phx.quote: 10. Checkers Level of dive: Open Water Depth: 15 - 18m

highlights.text: Potato bass, frogfish, snapper clouds

summary.text: A horseshoe-shaped ridge in Ponta Bay at 15-18 m, easy enough for open water divers. Clouds of snappers and fusiliers hang over it, with potato bass, morays, turtles and the odd frogfish.

phx.quote: 11. Steve's Ledge Level of dive: Open Water Depth: 13 - 19m Part of steps reef this area has some lovely Plate Coral with ledges and gullies hiding lots of life, Anemones and their Clownfish

highlights.text: Plate coral, clownfish, rays, grouper

phx.quote: 5. Kev's Ledge Level of dive: Advanced Depth: 19 - 25m The only Wall dive in the Ponta area

smoz.quote: Kevs Ledge is only for advanced divers with good drift experience. … Average depth is 24 metres (78 feet). There is a cleaning station and plenty of marine life.

highlights.text: Hawksbill turtle under the overhang
Nudibranchs along the wall; cleaning station

summary.text: A ridge and wall dive in the Ponta area with a big overhang where hawksbill turtles nap. Divers drift across several levels at about 24 m, so drift experience and advanced certification are expected.

phx.quote: 14. Pinnacle Level of dive: Advanced (confident diver) Depth: 28 - 45

highlights.text: Bull, hammerhead and dusky sharks in season

phx.quote: 16. Atlantis Level of dive: Advanced (experienced) Depth: 38 - 47m

mal.quote: Atlantis / Lego 50m It’s one of the deeper reefs with a reef structure that reminds us of a sunken, under water city

highlights.text: Square boulders like a sunken city
